issues.title: One-command build & test with green CI badge
issues.story: As a contributor, I want to build the project and run all tests with a single command and see a green CI status, so that I can develop with confidence.
acceptance_criteria: `swift build` succeeds from the repo root
`swift test` runs all suites, including ported ones
CI badge in the README shows main's status

issues.title: Run the ported TextMate core tests against the new engine
issues.story: As a contributor, I want to run the original TextMate core tests (ported) against the Swift engine, so that I know the port is behaviorally faithful.
acceptance_criteria: Ported storage + indexed_map tests run under `swift test`
A failing ported test fails CI

issues.title: SwiftPM skeleton: TextCore library + tests + executable
acceptance_criteria: Package.swift at repo root with a `TextCore` library target
Test target wired to the library

issues.title: Undo engine (command stack, coalescing)

issues.title: Type and delete text; cursor follows edits
issues.story: As a user, I want to type and delete text with the cursor following my edits, so that I can compose a document naturally.

issues.title: Undo/redo my edits (⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z)
issues.story: As a user, I want to undo and redo my edits with the keyboard, so that I can recover from mistakes.
acceptance_criteria: Undo restores text and caret position
A new edit after undo clears the redo stack

issues.title: Position mapping: line/column ↔ UTF-16 offset
acceptance_criteria: Correct for empty and trailing newlines

issues.title: Port remaining pure-C++ buffer tests + text utf8/decode/encode/ctype (~20) to green
UTF-8 validation & normalize utilities (spec: text/utf8, text/transcode)
See a file's text rendered in a window
issues.story: As a user, I want to open a text file and see its contents rendered in a window, so that I can start reading code.
acceptance_criteria: Window shows document glyphs from the buffer
Per-line layout from the text engine (no fake rendering)
Font and line-spacing configurable in one place

issues.title: Select text with mouse and keyboard
issues.story: As a user, I want to select text with the mouse and keyboard, so that I can copy or act on ranges.

issues.title: Scroll smoothly through large documents (≥10 MB)
issues.story: As a user, I want to scroll through large documents smoothly, so that I can navigate long files.
acceptance_criteria: Scrollbar reflects the full document extent
Rendering is virtualized (only visible lines drawn)

issues.title: Undo/redo wired into the UI
issues.story: As a user, I want undo/redo available from the menu and keyboard, so that I can recover mistakes without losing work.
acceptance_criteria: Edit menu shows Undo/Redo with correct enabled state

issues.title: Cut a release with one tag → signed, notarized .dmg
issues.story: As a maintainer, I want to cut a release by pushing a tag, so that users get a signed, notarized installer without manual steps.
acceptance_criteria: Pushing a v* tag triggers the release pipeline
Produces a signed + notarized .dmg (when secrets are set)
GitHub Release created with auto changelog
Unsigned artifact-only fallback works when secrets are absent
